name: Positional Encoding Unit (PEU)
definition: A hardware unit for computing different kinds of feature mapping functions (positional encodings) for neural radiance fields, specifically supporting inner product operations with vector sizes R=3 and R=6.
summary: The Positional Encoding Unit is a hardware accelerator that computes NeRF feature mappings via dedicated matrix multiplication and trigonometric logic, differing from software by offloading these intensive operations.
